purpose: starts or resumes work on issues

<reference>.description: the issues, each named with its tracker: 7, #7, or AB#4521; the first is the primary, and the one pull request closes them all

--title.description: creates an issue with that title and starts it; with references, creates it as their parent, as kit gather does, and starts it with them

--pr.description: adds the issues to one of the caller's own open pull requests instead: each is assigned to the caller and closed by it
